name: acad-parametric
description: Parametric drafting: geometric constraints via native -GEOMCONSTRAINT (Horizontal, Vertical, Parallel, Perpendicular, Coincident, Fix), DELCONSTRAINT cleanup, inventory of constraint proxy entities in model space, and dynamic BlockReference property get/set (visibility, lookup, distance, angle) without opening the Block Editor. Ships a dedicated P-* layer key for parametric annotation hygiene. Pairs with acad-validators under validators/parametric/. Full dimensional DIMCONSTRAINT workflows and Block Editor-only geometric constraints ship in Phase 7. KNOWN DEFECT (found 2026-07-29, live-tested): every apply_geom_* and apply_dim_* constraint-application tool currently fails against real AutoCAD with eInvalidInput from Editor.Command -- root cause not yet identified after three independent fix attempts. list_constraint_entities, get/set_dynamic_block_property, and ensure_parametric_layers are unaffected. See ParametricTools.cs header comment.

tools_summary.name: apply_dim_aligned
tools_summary.description: Apply an Aligned dimensional constraint between point1 and point2 via transparent -DIMCONSTRAINT (dimension line stays parallel to the point1-point2 line, unlike apply_dim_linear which is always horizontal/vertical), with its dimension text placed at placementPoint.

tools_summary.name: apply_dim_linear
tools_summary.description: Apply a Linear dimensional constraint between point1 and point2 via transparent -DIMCONSTRAINT, with its dimension text placed at placementPoint. Unlike geometric constraints, a dimensional constraint carries a numeric value that DRIVES the geometry -- editing it after creation moves whatever it's attached to. Point-pair form only (not the 'Object' pick mode -- see plugin source comment for why).

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_coincident
tools_summary.description: Apply a Coincident geometric constraint between two picks (handles a and b) via transparent -GEOCONSTRAINT. Works best on endpoints / points the solver can merge; whole-entity picks may fail depending on AutoCAD build. If the command rejects the pick set, constrain boundary polylines instead of hatch (rule 42 §8).

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_collinear
tools_summary.description: Apply a Collinear geometric constraint between two line-like entities (handles a and b) via transparent -GEOCONSTRAINT -- forces them onto the same infinite line.

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_concentric
tools_summary.description: Apply a Concentric geometric constraint between two circular/arc entities (handles a and b) via transparent -GEOCONSTRAINT -- forces their centre points to coincide.

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_equal
tools_summary.description: Apply an Equal geometric constraint between two entities of the same kind (handles a and b) via transparent -GEOCONSTRAINT -- two lines get equal length, two circles/arcs get equal radius.

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_fix
tools_summary.description: Apply a Fix geometric constraint to anchor one entity (datum behaviour per rule 42 §2). Call once per sketch for the construction corner — do not Fix every entity or the drawing becomes over-constrained.

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_horizontal
tools_summary.description: Apply a Horizontal geometric constraint to one line-like entity in the current space using AutoCAD transparent -GEOCONSTRAINT. The entity handle must reference a Line, polyline segment, or other object the solver accepts for Horizontal. Runs outside an MCP transaction — AutoCAD owns the command transaction.

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_parallel
tools_summary.description: Apply a Parallel geometric constraint between two curve entities (handles a and b) via transparent -GEOCONSTRAINT. Both entities must live in the same current space; mixed paper-space / block-context picks are undefined — resolve handles from the active viewport context first.

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_perpendicular
tools_summary.description: Apply a Perpendicular geometric constraint between two curves via transparent -GEOCONSTRAINT. Common pitfall: picking two lines that are already parallel to the UCS axes — the solver may report redundant constraints (rule 42 §3).

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_symmetric
tools_summary.description: Apply a Symmetric geometric constraint making entities a and b mirror images of each other about symmetryLine, via transparent -GEOCONSTRAINT. All three handles must already exist in the current space.

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_tangent
tools_summary.description: Apply a Tangent geometric constraint between two curve entities (handles a and b) via transparent -GEOCONSTRAINT. Typical use: a line tangent to an arc/circle, or two arcs tangent to each other.

tools_summary.name: apply_geom_vertical
tools_summary.description: Apply a Vertical geometric constraint to one line-like entity in the current space using transparent -GEOCONSTRAINT. Complements apply_geom_horizontal; do not stack both on the same line unless the office standard requires it.

tools_summary.name: delete_entity_constraints
tools_summary.description: Run transparent -DELCONSTRAINT on one entity handle to strip geometric/dimensional constraints attached to that object. Use before explode-freeze workflows or when rebuilding a sketch (rule 42 §4 — explode orphans constraints differently).

tools_summary.name: ensure_parametric_layers
tools_summary.description: Idempotently create the 6-layer parametric sketch key (P-CONSTRUCTION, P-SKETCH, P-CONSTRAINED, P-DYNAMIC, P-PARAM-LBL, P-NOTE) per rule 42 §9 with prescribed ACI colour, Continuous linetype, and lineweight. Existing layers are never overwritten.

tools_summary.name: get_dynamic_block_properties
tools_summary.description: Read all DynamicBlockReferenceProperty entries from a BlockReference handle: names, read-only flags, UnitsType, CLR type, and current Value. isDynamicBlock=false returns an empty list — the handle is still a block insert but not dynamic. Use the reference handle, never hard-code anonymous *U block names (rule 42 §6).

tools_summary.name: list_constraint_entities
tools_summary.description: Scan model space for database objects whose runtime class name contains 'Constraint' (constraint proxy / glyph entities). Optional layerFilter narrows results. Read-only with respect to geometry — still requires the plugin for DB access.

tools_summary.name: parametric_health
tools_summary.description: Return the 6-layer P-* parametric key, planned Phase-7 block roster, and the dynamic-block angle value policy string. Does not open AutoCAD.

tools_summary.name: set_dynamic_block_property
tools_summary.description: Write one DynamicBlockReferenceProperty on a BlockReference by name. Pass JSON booleans as true/false, numbers as JSON numbers. For Angle-typed properties the numeric value is interpreted as degrees and converted to radians in the plugin (see parametric_health.dynamicAnglePolicy). Strings are for lookup / text parameters. Read-only properties throw.

v1_limitations: Geometric constraints run via native -GEOCONSTRAINT Editor.Command — behaviour is locale/AutoCAD-build sensitive; Coincident on whole entities may require manual picks in some drawings.
DIMCONSTRAINT authoring, BEDIT-scoped block-definition constraints, and associative-network DOF analysis ship in Phase 7.
list_constraint_entities scans model space only (not every layout) and matches class names containing 'Constraint' — not a full associative-graph export.
Dynamic-block angle inputs are JSON numbers in degrees at the MCP boundary; the plugin converts to radians when UnitsType looks angular (substring 'angl').
